evidence: Claim 9 (두쫀쿠, Jan 2026 open-run and sold-out craze) and claim 12 (버터떡, rice-cake trend still covered in an article dated 2026-10-08) back the chewy rice-cake dessert theme; the other entries are variants of that theme. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 12 (버터떡 dessert trend, reported 2026-03-16 and still covered in an October 2026 rice-cake article) and claim 9 (두쫀쿠, the trend that preceded it) back the butter-dessert theme; the other entries are butter-based snack and dessert variants. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 13 (ube desserts and drinks spreading through Korean cafes and convenience stores from April 2026, positioned as the successor to matcha) backs the ube theme; all 12 entries are ube-flavored dessert or drink variants. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 15 (single-serve cup bingsu, about 1 million cups in about two weeks after its May 2026 launch) and claim 18 (early-summer heat lifted ice cream and chilled-drink sales in May-June 2026) back the summer cold-dessert theme. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 18 (early-summer heat lifted convenience-store chilled-drink sales, with peak summer sales starting almost a month early in May 2026) backs the summer cold-drink theme; the 12 entries are cold drinks and teas. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 14 (banana milk reported in 2026 as a top must-buy item at Korean convenience stores) backs the convenience-store milk-drink theme; entries are generic drink names, and no brand names are used. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 16 (Korean fruit exports grew in 2026, with first-half fruit exports up about 19.7% and fruit cited among food-export drivers; strawberries, pears and grapes named in the topic) backs the fruit-snack theme. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 17 (global chocolate demand softened in 2026 after the 2024-25 cocoa price spike, per reports dated March 2026) backs the chocolate theme; entries are chocolate snack and dessert variants. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 8 (반줄 김밥, a half roll of kimbap for about 2,500 won, covered by several outlets on 2026-09-15) and claim 7 (점심값 1만원 시대, a 2026 news phrase) back the lunch-and-snack theme. Claim numbers are 1-based.

Claim 5 (chia pudding, #4 in Google's 2025 year-end recipe searches) and claim 6 (hot honey, #1 food and recipe search; a condiment rather than a dish, so it is labeled as a sauce in its quip) back the 2025 search-trend snack theme; other entries are snack variants of that theme. Claim numbers are 1-based.
